skill.name: competitor-analysis
skill.description: Compare tracked app competitors in ASOScan using store categories, chart ranks, and ratings. Add rivals with confirmation and use keyword-spy for keyword gaps.
skill.summary: Assess app positioning against tracked competitors using ASOScan data and identify a specific improvement.

content.value_statement: App teams need comparable evidence to understand their competitive position. This skill guides ASOScan comparisons of tracked rivals and identifies a specific improvement.
actual_capabilities: Guide ASOScan account app discovery and tracked competitor retrieval through connected tools or authenticated API requests.
Compare primary store categories, current ratings, and rating counts across tracked apps.
Analyze category-rank momentum and distinguish measured non-charting results from absent measurements.
Compare rating histories for an app and its tracked competitors.
Add a competitor by store URL after confirmation, using write access and two API credits.
Structure a competitive report and incorporate keyword gaps obtained through the separate keyword-spy skill.
limitations: Requires connected ASOScan tools or shell access with a configured ASOSCAN_API_KEY.
Only covers account apps and tracked competitors; Apple secondary categories are not exposed.
Keyword gap analysis depends on keyword-spy, which is not included in this skill.
History may omit unmeasured dates, and recommendations cannot guarantee ranking improvements.

use_cases.title: Prioritize an app improvement
use_cases.description: Compare a product with tracked rivals and select one evidence-based improvement from category, rank, and rating trends.

use_cases.title: Review competitive momentum
use_cases.description: Assess category-rank changes for a selected country and distinguish non-charting measurements from missing dates.

use_cases.title: Monitor category positioning
use_cases.description: Compare primary categories and rating trajectories across tracked competitors before recommending a positioning change.

prompt_templates.title: Compare tracked rivals
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [app name] with its tracked competitors in [country]. Summarize primary categories and current ratings without changing account data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: obtain a basic competitive comparison.

prompt_templates.title: Assess rank and rating trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [app name] and its tracked rivals in [country] over 30 days. Explain category-rank momentum and available rating trends. Distinguish non-charting results from unmeasured dates.

prompt_templates.title: Add a competitor with approval
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare to add [store URL] as a competitor for [app name]. Confirm the two-credit cost and ask for approval before writing. After approval, compare available category and rating data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: expand the tracked competitor set with explicit consent.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize a competitive action
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [app name] against tracked rivals in [country] over [days] days. Use keyword-spy for keyword gaps when available. Separate observations from assumptions and recommend one specific action. Ask before writes, AI calls, or calls costing more than two credits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine performance trends and related keyword research.

output: The app was not charting on every measured date.

output_examples.output: Adding this competitor changes your tracked data and costs two API credits. Write access is required. Do you approve this addition?

best_practices: Choose the app, country, and comparison window explicitly before interpreting trends.
Distinguish measured non-charting results from absent dates, and report only observed values.
Confirm writes and costly calls, and keep API credentials out of visible output.
anti_patterns: Treating every null rank or absent date as missing data.
Adding competitors without confirmation or using credentials in visible output.
Inventing keyword gaps without keyword-spy results or promising guaranteed rank improvements.

faq.question: What does this skill compare?
faq.answer: It compares tracked apps using primary categories, category-rank history, and ratings. Keyword gaps require the separate keyword-spy skill.

faq.question: How does it connect to ASOScan?
faq.answer: It uses connected ASOScan tools first. Otherwise, it guides API calls when shell access and ASOSCAN_API_KEY are available.

faq.question: Can it analyze any app?
faq.answer: No. ASOScan access covers account apps and tracked competitors. Add a rival by store URL before requesting competitor history.

faq.question: Which operations cost credits?
faq.answer: The documented reads are free. Adding a competitor costs two credits and requires confirmation. AI calls and calls costing more than two credits need approval.

faq.question: What does a null category rank mean?
faq.answer: A null rank means the app was measured but was not in the tracked chart. Absent dates represent unmeasured dates.

faq.question: Will recommendations guarantee better rankings?
faq.answer: No. The skill identifies evidence-based actions, but it cannot guarantee ranking changes or supply unavailable measurements.
